EVIDENCE OF COMPLETION — merged.

Change: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2145 (LLM-Review+1, Verified+1, submitted; merged as ec028f59bd on main).

What landed: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_comment_dedup_seam_crossing.py — the seam-crossing dedup test with NO seeded invariants: the transport return comes from the REAL acli_cli_ops.add_comment (stubbed only at the _run_acli subprocess seam) fed the RECORDED ACLI batch envelope; recording via the REAL _record_comment_id against a REAL BindingStore; re-diff via the REAL _diff_comments on that SAME store. Jira-side body diverges from every local body so the secondary body-equality skip cannot mask an inert primary skip.

ACs:
- Recorded post skipped + unrecorded control still emits: DONE — test_recorded_post_is_skipped_and_unrecorded_control_still_emits.
- Inert-guard variant re-emits: DONE — test_inert_is_comment_mapped_reemits_the_recorded_comment (instance-level is_comment_mapped forced False → recorded comment re-emits).
- Discriminating power proven RED-first: hard-wiring the store guard False failed the seam test; probe removed before commit.

Gates: 2/2 tests pass; make lint (ruff + format + complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0); make typecheck clean; full CI Verified+1 across py3.11-3.13 ubuntu + macos.
